objects.constraint public.sso_domain_retirement_: FOREIGN KEY (retirement_id) REFERENCES sso_domain_retirements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth."user"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
objects.constraint public.sso_domain_retirements: CHECK ((((proved_at IS NULL) AND (retired_at IS NULL) AND (old_verified_at IS NULL) AND (old_expires_at IS NULL)) OR ((proved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (retired_at IS NOT NULL) AND (old_verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (old_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (proved_at >= created_at) AND (proved_at < expires_at) AND (retired_at >= proved_at) AND (old_expires_at > old_verified_at) AND (old_expires_at <= proved_at))))
FOREIGN KEY (old_organization_id, domain_id) REFERENCES sso_domains(organization_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (requesting_organization_id) REFERENCES auth.organization(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
objects.trigger public.sso_domain_retirements.ss: CREATE TRIGGER sso_domain_retirements_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON public.sso_domain_retirements FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_sso_domain_retirement() -- function SET search_path=public, pg_temp md5 a7300aa33e2757fc2b5eb4ae92d4c5ce
